result.summary: Found 2 issues: a major text truncation problem in the restaurant listing and a minor layout issue with category filters.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated in the 'Fastest near you' section, cutting off the full restaurant name
issues.suggestion: Adjust the card width or use text wrapping/ellipsis with proper constraints to ensure full restaurant names are visible or properly truncated with '...'

issues.description: Category filter buttons on the right side appear cut off (partially visible rightmost button beyond the visible area)
issues.suggestion: Add visual indicators (scroll hints or arrows) to show users that additional categories are available via horizontal scrolling, or adjust button sizing to fit better
